title: Promotions
description: Create explicit discount rules, review their scope, and activate them only when they are ready. Checkout always revalidates the current version.

empty.title: No promotions in this view
empty.description: Create a draft or choose another status. Drafts never change checkout prices until you activate them.

fields.name: Promotion name
fields.combinableHelp: Combine only with other eligible combinable rules. Priority still decides the order.

form.searchProduct: Search by product name or code
form.allCustomers: Leave empty for all customers or search for one
form.expiryReadOnly: Expiry offers are created from manager-approved radar suggestions and cannot be edited here.

toast.saveError: The promotion could not be saved
toast.transitionError: The promotion status could not be changed

checkout.unavailable: Promotions could not be verified. Checkout remains blocked so the customer is never charged from a stale price.

server.PROMOTION_NOT_FOUND: That promotion could not be found.
server.PROMOTION_TARGET_INVALID: The promotion target is invalid or belongs to another business.
server.PROMOTION_STATE_INVALID: The promotion changed or cannot perform that action in its current state.
server.PROMOTION_QUOTE_STALE: Promotions changed while checkout was open. Review the updated total and confirm again.
server.PROMOTION_EXPIRY_PHARMACY_FORBIDDEN: Expiry suggestions cannot become pharmacy promotions.
